passages.note: Third-person campaign page; requiring state-funded faith-based organizations to adopt a 'Wait Until 8th' smartphone policy is a funding condition, not an exemption from anti-discrimination law.

rows.reasoning: Neither campaign page addresses how wide religious exemptions from anti-discrimination law should be; the only mentions of 'faith-based organizations' concern a smartphone-policy funding condition and new-parent support providers. No passage speaks to any rung, from 'prohibit religious exemptions from civil rights and anti-discrimination laws' to 'complete autonomy in their operations and hiring practices'.
